_comment: Claims as the az-snp-vtpm verifier emits them, captured from a live boot
of an Azure Standard_NCC40ads_H100_v5 node. Every scalar is a string,
because parse_tee_evidence_az renders each one through format!, and the
PCR keys are zero padded under a tpm object by extend_claim.
init_data holds hex of PCR 8 rather than the initdata digest: the same
extend_claim overwrites the base64 host_data it was parsed from.
The tests derive the policy's reference values from the tpm values here,
so a rendered policy and this evidence cannot drift apart.
